# Factuality Auditor

> Hallucination detection built from scratch: extract atomic claims, verify them against a knowledge base, and produce a calibrated factuality judgment.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor

## Source

- [src/factuality_auditor/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/__init__.py): Factuality Auditor - hallucination detection and calibration from scratch.
- [src/factuality_auditor/calibration.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/calibration.py): Calibration metrics: is the auditor's confidence trustworthy? A confidence is well calibrated when, among predictions made with confidence around ``p``, a fraction close to ``p`` are correct.
- [src/factuality_auditor/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/cli.py): Command line interface for the factuality auditor.
- [src/factuality_auditor/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/data.py): A bundled knowledge base and a labeled set of answers to audit.
- [src/factuality_auditor/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/evaluation.py): Evaluate the auditor on detection and calibration.
- [src/factuality_auditor/extraction.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/extraction.py): Extract atomic factual claims from text as (subject, relation, object) triples.
- [src/factuality_auditor/knowledge.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/knowledge.py): A trusted knowledge base of facts used to verify claims.
- [src/factuality_auditor/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/factuality_auditor/scoring.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/scoring.py): Aggregate per-claim audits into a document-level factuality judgment.
- [src/factuality_auditor/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the factuality auditor.
- [src/factuality_auditor/text.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/text.py): Deterministic normalization and sentence splitting.
- [src/factuality_auditor/types.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/types.py): Core data types for the factuality auditor.
- [src/factuality_auditor/verification.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/factuality-auditor/blob/main/src/factuality_auditor/verification.py): Verify extracted claims against the knowledge base.
